deadline.value: Fall entry only. Apply by January 15 to be considered for an assistantship. The department also says applications are due February 1 for fall admission.
deadline.quote: Application must be received by January 15 to be considered for a graduate assistantship.

also.quote: Applications are due February 1 for fall admission.

gre_general.value: The chemistry PhD does not require the General GRE.
gre_general.quote: This program does not require the General GRE.

gre_subject.value: The chemistry pages checked do not mention a Chemistry Subject GRE.

toefl_min.value: The chemistry department requires TOEFL iBT 81 (internet-based), one point above the graduate-school minimum.

ielts_min.value: The chemistry department requires IELTS 6.5, the same as the graduate-school minimum.

supervisor.value: The chemistry pages checked do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Teaching assistantships with tuition awards are allocated competitively, so funding is not automatic.
funding.quote: Teaching assistantships include tuition awards and are available on a competitive basis for the fall and spring semesters.

entry_route.value: The department's stated requirement is a B.S. or B.A. in chemistry or higher, so a bachelor's degree is enough on the page.
entry_route.quote: A Bachelor of Science (B.S.) or a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in chemistry or higher

notes: Department page gives TOEFL and IELTS rules that replace the graduate-school minimums for this program. The department page is not a pure Fall rule: self-funded students can also apply for spring.
